findings.title: Use operating earnings and attributable profit consistently
findings.finding: The supplied annual statement reports EBITDA of ₹53,060.6 million and profit for the year of ₹34,990.8 million. Its EBITDA definition and associate results are shown separately in the statement.
findings.investor_use: Use the disclosed EBITDA definition consistently across peers. An earnings multiple and an enterprise-value multiple require different earnings and balance-sheet bridges.
